files.README.md:
# seaorm-ddl-postgresql

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities and SeaORM 2.0.4 descriptions of the tables, repositories and services, in asynchronous Rust. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: postgresql.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no type for.
- Services: take and return DTOs; updates take a Patch per field: Absent, or set to a value that may be None; errors are `Result<T, DomainError>`.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/database.rs          the connection of DATABASE_URL
src/unit_of_work.rs      the repositories of every table, and the transactions
src/errors.rs            DomainError: NotFound, Conflict, ValidationFailed, Database; no HTTP codes
src/entities/            one entity and one SeaORM description per table
src/repositories/        the repositories of each table
src/services/            one service per table
tests/data/              repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json       what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://app:app@localhost:5432/app" cargo test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

//! The "Order" table, as the database has it. SeaORM never creates or changes it: the database already exists.
//!
//! CHECK ("group" >= 0): the services check what they understand of it.

use sea_orm::entity::prelude::*;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, DeriveEntityModel)]
#[sea_orm(table_name = "Order")]
pub struct Model {
    #[sea_orm(primary_key, column_name = "Id")]
    pub id: i64,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "String(StringLen::N(40))")]
    pub user: String,
    #[sea_orm(default_value = 0)]
    pub group: i32,
    #[sea_orm(column_name = "customerName", column_type = "String(StringLen::N(60))", unique)]
    pub customer_name: String,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "Text", nullable)]
    pub class: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "Text", nullable)]
    pub metadata: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(nullable)]
    pub date: Option<chrono::NaiveDate>,
    #[sea_orm(nullable)]
    pub time: Option<chrono::NaiveTime>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "String(StringLen::N(20))", nullable)]
    pub text: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "Text", nullable)]
    pub list: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "String(StringLen::N(10))", nullable)]
    pub str: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(nullable)]
    pub int: Option<i32>,
    #[sea_orm(column_name = "dueDate")]
    pub due_date: chrono::NaiveDate,
    #[sea_orm(column_name = "closesAt", nullable)]
    pub closes_at: Option<chrono::NaiveTime>,
    #[sea_orm(column_name = "createdAt", nullable, default_expr = "Expr::current_timestamp()")]
    pub created_at: Option<chrono::NaiveDateTime>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "String(StringLen::N(10))", nullable)]
    pub kind_code: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(nullable)]
    pub kind_day: Option<chrono::NaiveDate>,
    #[sea_orm(nullable)]
    pub thing_id: Option<uuid::Uuid>,
    #[sea_orm(column_name = "parentId", nullable)]
    pub parent_id: Option<i64>,
}

#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, EnumIter, DeriveRelation)]
pub enum Relation {
    #[sea_orm(belongs_to = "crate::entities::thing_table::Entity", from = "Column::ThingId", to = "crate::entities::thing_table::Column::Id", on_delete = "SetNull")]
    ThingId,
    #[sea_orm(belongs_to = "Entity", from = "Column::ParentId", to = "Column::Id")]
    ParentId,
    #[sea_orm(belongs_to = "crate::entities::kind_table::Entity", from = "(Column::KindCode, Column::KindDay)", to = "(crate::entities::kind_table::Column::Code, crate::entities::kind_table::Column::Day)")]
    KindCodeKindDay,
}

impl ActiveModelBehavior for ActiveModel {}

//! The "things" table, as the database has it. SeaORM never creates or changes it: the database already exists.

use sea_orm::entity::prelude::*;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, DeriveEntityModel)]
#[sea_orm(table_name = "things")]
pub struct Model {
    #[sea_orm(primary_key, auto_increment = false)]
    pub id: uuid::Uuid,
    pub token: uuid::Uuid,
    pub small: i16,
    #[sea_orm(nullable)]
    pub num: Option<i32>,
    pub big: i64,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "Decimal(Some((10, 2)))")]
    pub price: rust_decimal::Decimal,
    pub r: f32,
    #[sea_orm(nullable)]
    pub d: Option<f64>,
    #[sea_orm(default_value = true)]
    pub flag: bool,
    pub born: chrono::NaiveDate,
    pub opens: chrono::NaiveTime,
    #[sea_orm(select_as = "time", save_as = "timetz")]
    pub opens_tz: chrono::NaiveTime,
    pub at: chrono::NaiveDateTime,
    pub at_tz: chrono::DateTime<chrono::FixedOffset>,
    pub bin: Vec<u8>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "custom(\"jsonb\")", select_as = "text", save_as = "jsonb")]
    pub data: String,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "custom(\"json\")", select_as = "text", save_as = "json", nullable)]
    pub plain: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "custom(\"\\\"mood\\\"\")", select_as = "text", save_as = "\"mood\"")]
    pub feeling: String,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "custom(\"text[]\")", select_as = "text", save_as = "text[]")]
    pub tags: String,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "custom(\"integer[]\")", select_as = "text", save_as = "integer[]", nullable)]
    pub numbers: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "custom(\"inet\")", select_as = "text", save_as = "inet", nullable)]
    pub ip: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "custom(\"interval\")", select_as = "text", save_as = "interval", nullable)]
    pub span: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "Char(Some(5))")]
    pub code: String,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "Text", nullable)]
    pub note: Option<String>,
    #[sea_orm(nullable, default_expr = "Expr::current_timestamp()")]
    pub changed: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::FixedOffset>>,
    #[sea_orm(column_type = "Decimal(Some((12, 2)))", nullable, extra = "GENERATED ALWAYS AS (price * 2) STORED")]
    pub total: Option<rust_decimal::Decimal>,
}

#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, EnumIter, DeriveRelation)]
pub enum Relation {}

impl ActiveModelBehavior for ActiveModel {}
